prompt: carpowerpolicyd aborts at boot on our build (see logcat.txt; there are no symbols in this checkout). Which function in which source file aborts, and what is the most likely cause? Answer in two lines. Do not change any file.
reference_answer:
CarPowerPolicyServer::applyPowerPolicy in packages/services/Car/cpp/powerpolicy/server/src/CarPowerPolicyServer.cpp (the CHECK at line 144) aborts.
The policy id 'vendor_suspnd_prep' is not registered (a typo of vendor_suspend_prep in the vendor policy config), so getPowerPolicy returns no policy.
